notes.title: Skyclimbers 2024 Update - Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9a7b36fb095ba3823a98c5f77202d7c1830bade1.gif[/img]

[h2]After a quiet period of intense development, we're excited to share a major update![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a2edd0ba6b518164b8b79789af9a7e42ca42d41f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/745d2db1d3842a5e06eb61f8301bc5ce34bf48ea.gif[/img]

[b]Player-built and procedurally generated settlements will become a strategic cornerstone, offering numerous benefits:[/b]

[list]
[*] 🪙[b]Automated Resource and Currency Generation:[/b] Once established, your settlements will continuously generate essential resources and currency, reducing the need for manual gathering.
[*] 🔨[b]Crafting, Repairing, and Upgrading Equipment: [/b]Villagers can craft, repair, and upgrade tools/weapons for you.
[*] 🏃[b]Fast Travel Destinations: [/b]Quickly traverse between settlements
[*] 🫱🏼‍🫲🏽[b]Trade:[/b] Engage in trade with other settlements, districts, and eventually dynasties, allowing you to exchange surplus resources and bolster your economy.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5c6e3861e6c5773dbfedcf21262b604f41c4b00d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2c5c1de56cbc03aa0d0815eeff36d6c03e433594.gif[/img]
Pick your townhall placement wisely, as it can't be moved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/75dda8afdef200d9ce5058a0beea438441530aea.gif[/img]
After placing the town hall villagers spring into action building its foundation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8865d7de4a428049849378ddc31dfb7c80c290b7.gif[/img]

[b]At the heart of every settlement is the Townhall. This central building sets the boundaries of your territory and serves as the recruitment center for your villagers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/78ed68aef135a80f63c29514ed662988c3a302ba.gif[/img]
Each villager can be moved around or assigned to buildings using point-and-click features. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/cb8b1f8c51bd9a0b0f5002f57f47ead274691a92.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3e211f1987366dbd0d77c52bcbc4d02b4d2d2415.gif[/img]
Houses are the foundation of your settlement, allowing for new population growth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c7e0084fce0408fe569a163df91c9ca2fc197f30.png[/img]

[b]Keeping your villagers satisfied is key to prosperity and productivity. [/b]Ensure adequate housing and maintain a surplus of resources like food and wood. A dissatisfied village won't attract new villagers, and existing villagers will work inefficiently. Unhoused villagers will refuse to work but will still consume resources. Players can also manually recruit villagers encountered during their travels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5219cc63430d3f19c0b076be6049b8aa2dba26ab.png[/img]

Villagers can be assigned to various roles, each contributing uniquely to the settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3ec1cc3e745c1be402502a3b75a8deb9947c74db.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/327b64787e99add83134d8f8f97bdcc455683601.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/235c7e21716c9e6c5a385122daa751f34e273edd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5599c1bb37fb85f1fc46272c9f5db9db3bce82ff.gif[/img]

[b]Farm:[/b] Villagers assigned to farms will plant and harvest crops, ensuring a steady food supply. All villages can plant and harvest basic grains, and converting grains through secondary buildings, such as a wheat mill, is planned. As the most vital resource, it's important to start a farm early in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ce8a9d4d45f7a7e2939833b53e36f2cd08b7b972.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/7fa2cbdaa3b3a5669f2972c71c4e7e2c3b2681c5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2163ed6a7d61230ba16004f9c7ac7331d7095b6d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e2ef51d173bc994fd23e0730642e937bd17e41d6.gif[/img]

[b]Sawmill: [/b]At the sawmill, lumberjacks will plant saplings and cut down mature trees, supplying the wood needed for construction and upkeep. Players can also cut down trees planted by villagers. Planting trees around the perimeter of the village can offer a tactical advantage. Upgrades to the sawmill can reduce tree growth time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/63f33a3c0ba21f6075b03b5f6558291775f9c34a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/031838bd86455d47b2bbaa141323a6da343fe26f.gif[/img]

[b]Mine:[/b]Villagers working in mines will extract valuable minerals and stones. Mines operate continuously but will eventually exhaust all stone in the region, freeing the player from the time-intensive task of managing mining operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/94f97edecabd54cdda4c6e63697f5a79f760fa8b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e3e2062fd0609c8c3c32009c78a0d9b5147567dc.gif[/img]

[b]Barracks:[/b]Assign villagers to the barracks to train them as guards, ensuring your village is well-defended. There are three sub-categories: infantry, heavy infantry, and ranged units. While villagers can defend themselves, a trained militia offers far stronger protection. A detailed breakdown of unit types is provided in part 2 of this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e3baa070d43925396f17b00f22ed5a3bb098c9b1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3ab8e230ffe542ef63326e8695c35dfef5ae8ced.gif[/img]

[b]Blacksmith:[/b] Smiths will craft, repair, and upgrade tools for both players and villagers. Upgrading this building is crucial, as it can boost resource generation. When integrated with trade routes, blacksmiths can also become a profitable asset.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/dc65bd72c52f9b3075ae9b0123d163b1487e6ba2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/32514ce98336408dd428b5d5d119f0ee96ea5789.gif[/img]

[b]Tavern: [/b]Tavern owners will sell food and general goods. While taverns can be found throughout the overworld, yours will serve as a hub for trade. You can also purchase items from your taverns at reduced prices. Villagers gather at taverns for recreation, boosting overall happiness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2c88dc3b71e6f9c83914e8904aafa4dcbd2fe4f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/397f01b9fe868a61df139f784c7eb29132b7c729.gif[/img]
[b]Player-built settlements will periodically face random raids by groups of Voidlings or Yagi. These hostile forces will target both villagers and buildings, posing a significant threat to your community. During raids, villagers can be killed, and those who are injured will require healing.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/760e980dd121e22d1c1df86070bcd5fdb70c4b1e.gif[/img]
[b]Every month, the appearance of a Dark Moon will herald even larger and more formidable raids, escalating the danger to your settlement. Preparing for these assaults and strategically utilizing your guards will be crucial for your village's survival.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/300895a086903d0e2bb28b99dcff09dc96574ec9.gif[/img]
[b]By carefully managing and expanding your settlements, you can create a powerful and self-sufficient network that supports your broader objectives. Failing to do so can result in the destruction of your kingdom. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c7875b50a7deba897ba56ca890f68d1bde86d829.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/f6c6d897f3ae10ce98e41cd6edfdd1db57ed898c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d2027f5e27271cdb26f93084b54a0cd9cc21a50b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/25b6ea7df23f2a56a7abfa263c393f33824fd8e8.gif[/img]
[h3]The improved world algorithm will dynamically generate diverse villages and cities alongside player-created settlements. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d145c1ad1ec57bcb3c0f7a713fb685e80f2e70a8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/230a24184200f1f8f9f7cc4ac4c322972fa02393.gif[/img]
[b]To integrate these villages into their expanding kingdom, players must first improve diplomatic relations. Positive relations are essential for negotiating a purchase price and recruiting villagers from these settlements. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4c7ffb0c10025aa14cf2548f825c31d30928cc99.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/7add243118ae9adefc26ffedd9e33732717fd9dc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ab60c8508c08bd9ff1452b28bce2071be835b864.gif[/img]
[b]These procedurally generated settlements will differ in resource type, density, specialist availability, and population size. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a83b553371d8d87db26216fe7921fe577963d5c8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/790b3585c2c4f597d7354dd47a5a82ca70d1cfba.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2226f86a78eeae861857646867aa1b3b3b605658.gif[/img]
[b]Built on three core pillars—resource generation, housing, and governance—these villages evolve naturally through different Eras.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/44e627af13a9e985193f8653b973a9f2cbc9c1c2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/56d6750d2b0b5779bda838c4abe54e6b7e0a97e6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d9c4dd8d7285ac8474a19673cba80cb71beab7a6.gif[/img]
[b]Players can enhance diplomatic relations by trading key resources and assisting villages with tasks such as bounties, dispatching enemy camps and activating Shoi points of interest. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b00962819a199fc9ba2fcd274d3c5fa4439c505a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/14487a21f8ecafc9392eb8430ad538b1165b8b41.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/14dd8ab7ba166cf8016a73a2ee97459c27602f7f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/122932057728f8f31e21c945a0b1837296abddfc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/7080b051b7eb2872448acab1f0603c2cff8a2268.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e24fcbf6a629812de073e5b7c7285ffdeedd793e.gif[/img]
[b]These actions will solidify alliances, making generated villages valuable allies that seamlessly integrate with player-built settlements.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/10dc784c0ee6c8f5f7bd8d42486b543a02fb09cb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/71e523b4a253583a94073f3ad0cb73bcb3be0045.gif[/img]
[b]By connecting player-built and procedurally generated villages through diplomacy, you can establish a robust trade network and strengthen your strategic position. Allied villages will support the player during times of need, providing additional security and resources.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ebb7a72f0034b979811720886f18dc795e62c57a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ca386bfae1a7bd34696222b197d6cadd507cd086.gif[/img]
[b]For those who prefer not to construct their own settlements, these generated villages offer a convenient and efficient alternative.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4407f279d05ee5f73a642f91e0ae74ea329ca408.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d04282328e69728095da41d3eb1eed99d6b0dad4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/17565374af43ff1207415f491ecace82ee8a849f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a3abc58ce95683eb30964860962428738574b1e4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/02c1ab9e56489be7c8c506290cdf6b8998c4d699.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a4c02cc4e40721c55db00b69285b7320a4452f75.gif[/img]
[h3]Town halls are the center of any settlement, where villagers come to feast, and make decisions.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5ff76c3270f72554d7e4ad85c95398acf23cf5f6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/13cfd500185a6fd4e0edab82c0815cf7eec3fbaa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c6d8a91f044898bd177ba57b91b554c636efbffa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/fe7f08325463219ea8d52fee3fc9bb016a339246.gif[/img]
[b]Courtyards contain ancient statues and viewing areas of the village. [/b]Some Shoi artifacts remain as ruins until their true purpose is later uncovered. Richer villages will feature more ornate structures, and blueprints for statues and decorations can be acquired through purchase or quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c6747a0640d195104b961bb333c76bb83b8bbec3.png[/img]
[h2]Districts are a new design classification for the biomes and their inhabitants of the Skyclimbers universe.[/h2]
[h3]Each district is being developed into a sub-culture within each given Dynasty, adding further depth, replayability, and design opportunities while showcasing distinct architectural styles, cultural traits, and gameplay elements.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2e0622e1e177fa38613384a698c56ef5d007995c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b9181f9600fa4a8ac23f461e7fab3fc9e6e339f8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/aafad4504503c8fd70bcc3008f780645f3560fcb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/bf4ea5feba668d4121a048840ae56528c6483e14.gif[/img]
[b]Villagers from the District are similar in appearance, aligning with the overall Dynasty and Era theme. [/b]The first Era Drakonian design draws significant inspiration from Vikings. Historic District rivalries and trade relations will influence gameplay opportunities. Districts still honor the elemental theme of their Dynasty; for the Drakonians, this is represented by a Magma-themed banner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a3adb1c69137487ea21aee1f31efb9a9572c138b.gif[/img]
[b]Jarls are key figures within the District, making decisions about war, territory, and trade.[/b] Building relations with Jarls can lead to alliances, trade benefits, and quest opportunities. Each settlement is governed under a jarl, and some powerful leaders may command multiple settlements with large militias. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5bcce9d58d8b12e6e47fa36594d45209e91b6781.gif[/img]
[b]Each building follows a similar construction style, using resources gathered from its biome.[/b] All Districts are currently being developed through the first Era, with base attributes carrying over into future Eras. You can collect blueprints from various Districts to expand your building options. Character customization options will also be tailored to your chosen District.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8b6e1ae0d6ab319b127523b1f463821c3b01430a.gif[/img]
[h3]Players can choose one of three paths to unification:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Diplomacy:[/b] Purchase and unite the districts, fostering cooperation and peace. 📜

[*] [b]War:[/b] Conquer the districts through force, establishing dominance. ⚔️

[*] [b]Isolation: [/b]Do nothing. Keep a neutral stance while completing the main quest. 🛖
[/list]
[b]The diplomatic landscape of the districts and dynasties will evolve throughout the game, with friends becoming enemies and adversaries turning into allies.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/1a6b063dfaa1d280342b0492c0ebc1e4eb15b23a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4e689cc7f6d8a3d95463798756c99bb8314b9b5b.gif[/img]

[h3]The Coastal Meadow variant of this Paladin class will be used for all demonstrations, as each district offers unique armor, hairstyles, and weaponry. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a2e11de963c3cd4d505149fc2c2ffd191b05c233.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b2dd1448ef3dd65cd755a451a1442c69fe848255.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4b2e794fb335636e9207374cdd7f1fe3ac883130.gif[/img]


[h3]Our first completed District; the Coastal Meadow, features wide landscapes with ominous dark mountains, heavy fog, and sporadic small forests. [/h3]

Locals are known for striking green eyes to match the serene vistas, and contrasting orange shades of hair grown into elaborate braids atop stocky builds. Their culture originates from ancient seafaring peoples who moved inland for the great Magmaton migration hunt. 

Their homes are largely wood, though the great beams of a town hall require imported logging from the Deep Forest locale, which is an integral trade partner. The dark tough stone found throughout this district became a major export and is commonly found throughout home foundations and chimneys. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ef3d8f07a9663e6c2ab3215c317bd88081e8c791.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3e551f648f8b299a6739402634398f0665006187.gif[/img]

[h3]Drakonians of the Ocean District are adapted for life at sea, with shipmaking, fishing, and adept swimming techniques commonplace.[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/bd30144eac3ac53cb72b848a9308d1a08ea81adf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ec1186e8940ec3299f88c932f2411dddd2a4e577.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/f81af501ab8bee8fbd7173db51ad43cc1466f1c4.gif[/img]

[h3]Their survival is tied to the ocean's bounty, relying on time-honed navigation skills and sturdy vessels to traverse the open waters.[/h3]

Locals are known for their blue eyes, light hair, and slender but athletic builds, shaped by years of physical labor both on land and at sea. Their architecture reflects the harsh coastal environment, with homes built from dried thatch and resistant stone foundations to withstand the corrosive ocean air and relentless winds. Many structures are elevated or fortified to guard against rising tides and powerful storms.

Their deep connection to the sea has made them fierce and resourceful. Life here is simple but resilient, with a strong sense of community rooted in seafaring traditions, rituals to honor the ocean, and a shared understanding that the waters can be both generous and unforgiving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9c347ad57e16bdf9e28d278b54d0d26100bbafe3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/79cbd4bdedfcaab1c3d3360262104468c1947546.gif[/img]

[h3]Drakonians of the Deep Forest Biome are reclusive, living among the ancient groves of conifers set between cascading mountains. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/cab8aab50c6f2ef307f49425a55d51ab819caa52.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8ad852600581c78ba15456e02f08a43b089d79d7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8ea6006abdddeec15ecc15826e7ee6933b59a8ab.gif[/img]

[h3]Known for their contrasting jet-black or snow-white hair, and tall muscular builds, Drakonians of the Deep Forest remain an enigma to the other districts. [/h3]

After migrating from the coastal meadow a millennia before, these peoples have adapted to the cold climates and daunting landscapes with unique traditions. An old-growth forest can remain connected with their ancestors, and it is forbidden to harvest such trees without careful consideration. 

Rich with wood and ore, this District is profitable, but is difficult to traverse, making trade restricted to the major roads and towns of the area. Construction methods rely heavily on timber, cured to a dark tint under flame to make it resistant to rot and corrosion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4595b664104375d626efc07da02ea03ca637805b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3313b05dc29a86a69600575eb8d2b5bc7178a2f9.gif[/img]

[h3]Drakonians of the Gyser Plains District are a hardy people able to weather the extreme warm and cold periods of the region. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/17bc298da80702ef242938b332b5bb77eca17ce5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4246d6b7d88b4afd45279b9340d43e217c101e34.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3a5744fbd414e46ba8a196f10082a51b4e11cc48.gif[/img]

[h3]Featuring wide, open plains where steam regularly bursts from the ground below them, and vibrant vegetation thrives on the fertile soil of this majestic landscape. [/h3]

The ground is alive with the pulse of geothermal energy, creating a rare balance of beauty and danger. During the harvest season, fertile soil leads to surplus crops needed through the cold winters. 

Locals are distinguished by their brown hair, often worn in intricate braids and their practical, earth-toned clothing that allows for freedom of movement in this unpredictable land. Their lifestyle revolves around the geyser pools, which they use not only for agriculture but for crafting and daily routines.

Homes are built from stone and timber, designed with raised foundations to protect against the heat rising from the surface. Growth-covered roofs blend into the plains and provide natural insulation. The people of the Gyser Plains extract a notable purple pigment from the crystalized lotus plant found here used for clothing and decoration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2ec58f52a56b462a90876ab0fbbb834c7853ea62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2aec6e12ae5502e962eb72816f5c338582efe05c.gif[/img]

[h3]Drakonians of the Magma District boast high tolerance to heat, making use of unique clothing and lifestyle choices to adapt within the scorched landscape. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/279c3382bf5e534821875d6812250a9b36d433d3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b02073117451bbcedf2834228531cbaa607ecf2a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/1de3f4b445b7c3eddcef11d50db8f19ee9cdccf2.gif[/img]

[h3]These Drakonians have evolved a remarkable tolerance to extreme heat, thriving in an unforgiving volcanic landscape where most would falter. [/h3]

Their clothing is crafted from fire-resistant materials, using light yet durable fabrics that allow them to endure the scorching air. Every aspect of their life is shaped by the molten rivers and ash-filled skies that dominate their surroundings.

The inhabitants are distinguished by their red hair and intense, sharp features. Physically, they possess muscular, rugged builds, hardened by the harsh conditions. Tattoos are prominent, often representing strength, protection, or their deep connection to the land.

Their homes are built from volcanic stone and fire-resistant ash, designed to resist tremors and withstand eruptions. Lava serves as a natural resource, used not just for crafting weapons and tools but also in rituals honoring the great Arraxos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[h3]Skyclimbers won’t be released to Early Access in 2024, but we’re continuing to make steady progress toward key milestones. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e4fca341a45c4f33344021a6183c16333af72d97.png[/img]

[h3]Our roadmap needs an update to reflect the necessary milestones that lie ahead. [/h3]

[h3]Beta 1 - 2025[/h3]

This milestone will focus on completing the single-player game loop for the Drakonian Dynasty, including all 5 classes, districts, and character creation within the first Era. Although major progress has been made, several key systems are still under development.
[list]
[*] Existing Alpha backers have immediate access with their Steam keys
[*] A "Pre-Beta" patch will be rolled out to the Alpha channel before launch
[*] Skycon will coincide with the Beta release, showcasing gameplay and trailers
[/list]
[h3]Beta 2 - 2025/2026[/h3]

The second Major Beta phase will introduce the Foryoku Dynasty. Feedback from the first Beta will be integrated. 
[list]
[*] Foryoku Dynasty content will parallel Drakonia with 5 districts for the first Era
[*] A limited round of new participants will be invited to join the testing phase
[/list]

[h3]Early Access - 2026 [/h3]

To enter Early Access, features from Beta 1 and 2 will be expanded based on feedback, and the Rokkuhito Dynasty will be added as a playable faction. Co-op Multiplayer will also be integrated. 
[list]
[*] Early Access marks the official release of Skyclimbers
[*] Increased likelihood of cross-platform availability at launch
[*] All three Dynasties—Drakonian, Foryoku, and Rokkuhito—will be feature complete
[/list]

[h3]As we progress, we will continue to update this roadmap to reflect our development milestones.[/h3]

[i]Given the challenges of meeting previous timelines and considering our limited team's size, we're taking a more direct approach to manage expectations. We're focused on steady progress and delivering Skyclimbers with the quality and depth it deserves, while keeping expectations aligned with our realistic goals. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]
[h3]This was the longest gap in community updates since the Kickstarter was funded, and we aim to improve moving forward. [/h3]

[i]Quiet periods from a developer can be alarming, and your patience is much appreciated. [/i]

[b]We plan to keep updates more frequent from here on out and thank the community for supporting Paratope through the years. [/b]

Until next time.

[h3]⚠️ Click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1362000/announcements/detail/4531276657004118122]here[/url] to read the second half of the update! [/h3]

notes.title: Skyclimbers 2024 Update - Part 2
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to part 2 of the Skyclimbers 2024 update![/h2]

[h3]Make sure to read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1362000/view/4669760442588937320?l=english]part 1[/url] first...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/1a40b4ea04d3903240617c1c345c1773c6abe5ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/38e3b0a063d21823a27fe353604c9e0fb961da5d.gif[/img]
[h3]Each class has multiple weapon types and unique combos. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e3f7093cd39b3da28dd1620515eb0fa724f5a491.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/bade1b969bf7ea1e282e7631768101467ddd75a8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b552f04cada18a64897e52486355dc3aa39d6dd8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/0772aa6f5234f9553328be352f6843ddd2109ef1.gif[/img]
[b]The Paladin can wield a variety of melee weapons, including swords, spears, axes, and hammers.[/b] Each weapon type has its own attack speed, range, and durability. One-handed weapons allow players to carry a shield for defense, while two-handed weapons offer more power but leave players vulnerable during attacks.

Most weapons will degrade over time, encouraging reliance on smiths to maintain a robust armory. Players will need to strategize carefully, managing their loadouts or adapting to the weapons they come across the world. While the Paladin has access to class-specific arms, the game also features common melee weapons that can be wielded by any class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/669a41eca9cbaee7a64fddaaeaa1d60c6d0aceed.png[/img]
[h3]Your militia is made of units trained with one of three sub-classes. [/h3]
As your village grows, you’ll need to construct a building for each unit type, along with securing sufficient resources and population to support your militia. A growing war camp will enable you to defend your settlements or venture out to the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8802960c93c3979ea11e7d591717365f85b41bc9.gif[/img]
Ranged units can be archers, slingshots, or later-era technology equivalents. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d50bdd8d16e83d821dba0884608e746450780869.gif[/img]
Standard infantry carry melee weapons and light armor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3178efb43939f1c4d001c226725dcc6e7e356fd7.gif[/img]
Heavy Infantry units carry the thickest armor and largest weaponry. 
Each unit carries a balance of damage, defense, and stamina, along with formation-specific behaviors that can be countered with the right tactics. Certain Districts are known for their exemplary units, and future iterations will include companion Sentius to their ranks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9f2ddb9df4be3a6aba5000144532cc3b6e4d8c07.gif[/img]
Units fight alongside you in battle and follow commands.
[b]Bringing the right units to each conflict will make for better results. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/504473e48b6e7ee88e5f0cf449705c05b296f46c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/59ea65615a87afb4e62ce4658d9954305b60015c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/6c976604ef6349be8c00fa9d9ef70ffc454a3efe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3783057bae116fab5f3133c6a05fdab55f631849.gif[/img]
[b]Larger battles may require multiple unit types.[/b]
Warfare is expensive, and you must be strategic with which battles you pick, as rebuilding the militia takes time and resources while leaving the settlement vulnerable to raids. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e4320b85a5134d8c9b99d03b6788ea7af868a517.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2c9d4aeed4d80dd44abb23d340b5fa334eefcea3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a09cfeba58c73cc947b8b80103580c8f3040cc5c.gif[/img]
[b]It's up to you as the commander to build a strategy.[/b]
Basic commands such as follow, hold, attack, and line formations are the foundations of unit combat tactics which the player can apply over any scenario to their wish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4e61e353507acea04dfd699369dce55ccf8d3994.gif[/img]
[b]Squabbles with the opposing clan can lead to major battles.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/fdec18a0b6ce62dcca64d33d36718a96db9ebf61.gif[/img]
[b]Voidlings will fight both sides should the battle run into night time.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/fc8f9e74a58e0942fd3a27ab1bbe6eeffd80524f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/6b909e18b1984cfac00bbc7e9b79a34e9c88f820.gif[/img]
[b]Hordes of Void can overrun powerful units with numbers. [/b]
Void and Yagi bases will spawn near your town hall, gathering resources and building their armies. Clearing out Yagi and Void camps will reduce their strength, but raids are inevitable at some point. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/87b42b3f67a905ad4cef2f8d700923d2b579d815.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/cd93f9bd920cec7a505620f780de55d0b7c3e454.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/27689f9d4c16a5d6074a334eec234635cbb6d1ff.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/63ba4fbcd65eed86c3be61b19579ef4a369e5c10.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/cf571dad12ca4b8fa64d18b6a3fd19b26d8dd8fa.gif[/img]
[b]Players can now swim and dive in large bodies of water, with swimming consuming stamina. Additionally, resources can be gathered underwater.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9c01dd632a44928cb883291ae88bceadbc925fa6.gif[/img]
[b]The new free-climbing system offers improved fluidity and maneuverability. [/b]Players can now climb most surfaces they encounter, from cliffs to buildings. Climbing consumes stamina, requiring strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4c908422f634f7bdc622411becaff6afa2378577.gif[/img]
[b]Players can now glide through the air from high places using a paraglider.[/b] It's especially useful for covering large distances or safely descending from great heights. Like swimming and climbing, using the paraglider will consume stamina.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9dc3435ec517cd581c496cd053c81ccc9174d46d.gif[/img]
[b]Alongside new locomotion methods, walking and running have been revamped with responsive new sub-states.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4672b5532ee8cccc1e2da5a06d6e03129c2dd2c8.gif[/img]
[b]The stamina bar can now be found as a pyramid-shaped icon near the player on screen, making it easier to manage stamina-consuming actions without having to glance at a distant corner[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/1b30c011223d6fa74cf68c511a815a17e7d82ab6.gif[/img]
[b]The resource depletion system has been reworked to be more user-friendly. Gathering plants and ground pickups now requires only a single button press. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a3ebf2f1da914d0c2101875c611fae61a6966bb7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4fde3b80c1d52f0f133fadfaec7499e2eae2d3c4.gif[/img]
[b]Mining and woodcutting are no longer restricted to the multi-tool.[/b] Any weapon or tool can be freely used to deplete stone and trees, without the burden of long animations or cooldowns when gathering resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/af4ccbe306d4a26b16e06c4ea1fdc68b8ac9007b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/5ba895551ee6a0f42aa9e8a1a3bfe0c1ed09c78c.gif[/img]
[b]Albarott are key species in the ocean biome ecosystem, making nests on rocky islands.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/12ba771e7b3d3442abd7f7e56ea5c7f398f68386.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8bd58af6bf3f7f9f325a6ac306d40bff8b7a6984.gif[/img]
[b]Orcalf and Orchydro make use of a new underwater herding algorithm.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4a14c237cc8a60699ec7ac7d7f629799fe371c5b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/551e0295e292869ac4ee5d23c76126991d088e97.gif[/img]
[b]Companion Sentius will follow you on foot or wing, accompanying you on your journey.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/76c8914699c20bebaa7834a149928db506086b0e.gif[/img]
[b]Villagers can own domestic Sentius such as Yacabur for food, labor, and companionship.[/b]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/bbb4d83e1f0e9f466cb29384fb331146e7ae0b7d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/852caa96b6906b0420879a66ac4644c35126518d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/241b962b3081d1d85b6455f901057558a7ed9f83.gif[/img]
[b]Super rare Sentius such as Thracion may flee when you approach them.[/b] Encounters are rare, so you’ll need to choose wisely before making your move. Certain quests may also be tied to locating these elusive Sentius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3653e5ce7898e6338ce363181b491d897f04334c.gif[/img]
A family of Stagma, Fawsaught, and Fawnra in the Deep Forest district. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/9c8e77dc3c9cb02bb13a37dc732968004e3254d8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/156f78932ac27e161e312ae9a90318eba7c8af07.gif[/img]
[b]Taking on a pack of hostile Sentius can be challenging, even with a companion. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c298eef3259bf6e34425051850401700e2b3cc48.gif[/img]
[b]You can watch your Sentius fight, but you may need to step in if more hostiles join the battle.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e680d3f04cac2e9e7d1579b83a73e99ed996324d.gif[/img]
[b]Your companion Sentus may flee to avoid fainting during battle. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/22246bbaba6cdb6ce4dc8ce1ee50b9d85963b93b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/351498dc0ab132871f4a13bae3ba5d2fabb8e012.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3baa017613a964ada83e596cd2808ba767e1c3fd.gif[/img]

[b]By working with Raikit, the Paladin takes out each Lupyre individually.[/b] Bringing the right Sentius can make all the difference—use elemental advantages. Night is especially dangerous, so keep track of high-level Sentius species and their home biomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/170c901536db83842c3c60c5b7ee14d7bcbf0246.gif[/img]
Aerapterix guarding its young in the Gyser plains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e25b2c22be35ad1155c220a9df7997d2720d14a5.gif[/img]
Raptra is hungry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/615c2ae18da45a99f2d6654af8e065cd7b6ee547.gif[/img]
Aerapterix isn't happy to see the player, and is ready for a fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/15b0f27255c70f46d73fa7e6cd902bf8c6247a7a.gif[/img]
[b]Third-stage Sentius evolutions are mini-bosses, with high stats and dangerous attacks. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a7c49e98a280a57249f9123d3624b0b732f8edd2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/586106e817f7101a3ba388d9c11188afd31af85a.gif[/img]
[b]Defeating these Sentius requires practice and an understanding of their tactics and strengths. [/b]Elemental advantages can make all the difference in battles like these. If you're trying to tame Sentius at this level, the right preparation is essential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/148fe4c7e3a5b731337c63cf48f9f0f74eb1f538.gif[/img]

[b]The Magma District is home to high-level Sentius, and Magmacano is a particularly tough opponent.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/479fa466b3cd8a6dca89102d96de0d3cb96734cc.gif[/img]
With multiple ranged attacks, timing your strikes is crucial!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/6bf15e2b782eeb8c2e8ac2e5034c14118c59c92c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/6696428bbb0a144a5151a0bf4f2f31341233bde8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/abbbb16fbdbe2bf8cbf2ec1b9fadcc836dd0aaef.gif[/img]

[b]The center biome of each continent is the most dangerous, featuring high-level Sentius and unforgiving terrain.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/560b008a0caef7c9e6bc44895f22ee2437809a5a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/297a8200a11d62b0297cb8784066e728a19de1a8.gif[/img]
[b]A brand new sky and weather system has been integrated, bringing new developmental and artistic possibilities.[/b] As before, it includes time of day progression, but now also features a range of weather conditions such as rain, thunderstorms, snow, and fog. Different biomes will have distinct weather patterns. Weather is now paired with audio and particle systems to create biome-specific ambiance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8b77f784aee8071e6f268e66c89bb9648ec99ec5.gif[/img]
[b]Hex is the nearby moon of Lithan, your home planet. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/2725d7e02a3cb7406c9a54a95456adcade9bf516.gif[/img]
[b]A planetary neighbor of three unknown Dynasties can now be seen on the horizon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/f26a6106abec84014ab0b3e2d2a41be4f77330dd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/1d4ab320614fea08d2051858f52cb166e951ccd0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ed679ea09d9f861b60ad9ab7eaa37bc88aa5b976.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/20762fd7be6e3af10bee85dd00764feb7483ca32.gif[/img]
[b]A new clustering and spatial partitioning algorithm enables denser forests with better performance. [/b]Clustering allows for more efficient memory management, keeping usage low and preventing stuttering. Combined with a new level of detail management system, it improves performance by reducing the number of objects rendered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/7cbe8a2ee047022b0cd7f68363a72ef1b9a5f090.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/088a517eb8b87713a1e59063fd8becf17681c222.gif[/img]
[b]AI (humanoid and Sentius) now employ a wide array of combat behaviors, including dodging, parrying, and strafing.[/b] An entity management system optimizes processing power through parallelization and memory pooling. With these techniques combined, the engine now supports large-scale real-time battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/747dc8a5913c12efbd64172a6bbee4cb23c1be86.gif[/img]
[b]Night-time rendering is brighter in the overworld with more accurate colors. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/57fe8f67321673a0874bf889236a88d548ceb16e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/bc608209be2297ade2d6adc6f0463d0b2bc0056f.gif[/img]
[b]Scenes now support more dynamic lights, with better shadow detail. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[h3]The world algorithm now features 5 biome continent generation with an infinite ocean border. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/987944910e178d4ba36d1e1bac36b74be2349204.gif[/img]
[b]Reaching the ocean biome can take hours, depending on the continent's size. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/799d9cc7d01e824ebfe387914dd70ed69403091f.gif[/img]
[b]Border zones feature formations from both neighboring biomes.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/adf23c687c6022f8b5dd205c25112c897c07500a.gif[/img]
[b]Longer render distances for terrain allow you to see the upcoming biome, with improved performance thanks to a custom detail loading system.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/0012bd149b9d4d0b61802f35623f9f85d8edeb07.gif[/img]
[b]Weather and ambiance profiles adapt dynamically to each new location. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d99ca6b648ce3e3a2399917b8f7ced53fae4f274.gif[/img]
[b]New lighting transitions during dawn and dusk feature light scattering. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]
[h3]Where are the other Dynasties?[/h3]
[b]Our resources are best focused on completing the single-player core loop, using Drakonia as the foundation for the other dynasties throughout the first Era.[/b]
[list]
[*] Dozens of pre-production art assets are still being developed for other Dynasties
[*] Drakonia’s development helps us prototype and refine systems that will be shared across all Dynasties
[*] This approach helps us maximize time and minimize backtracking
[/list]
[h3]When will the next playable build be available?[/h3]
[b]The next playable build is expected in 2025, before Beta 1.[/b] Due to limited resources, we cannot focus on gameplay development and resolving bugs or performance issues that would come with a build release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/293754a8d81184c604a4047c846c9c6c3073d7b1.png[/img]

[b]Paratope is independently funded and has chosen to self-publish to retain creative control. To support the team, consider purchasing something from the merch [url=https://www.etsy.com/shop/Skyclimbers]store![/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/d6d48a55b2554af2c987aef6cde800ec37ac59fc.png[/img]

[b]We also have a long-awaited plush pillow for Akaneko that will launch along with the Beta release. [/b]
Sign up [url=https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/52376640-a02e-4c04-a6a4-4851e7c1bbea/landing?ref=c-main-page]here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[i]Below is a copy from part 1 👇[/i]

[h3]Skyclimbers won’t be released to Early Access in 2024, but we’re continuing to make steady progress toward key milestones. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e4fca341a45c4f33344021a6183c16333af72d97.png[/img]

[h3]Our roadmap needs an update to reflect the necessary milestones that lie ahead. [/h3]

[h3]Beta 1 - 2025[/h3]

This milestone will focus on completing the single-player game loop for the Drakonian Dynasty, including all 5 classes, districts, and character creation within the first Era. Although major progress has been made, several key systems are still under development.
[list]
[*] Existing Alpha backers have immediate access with their Steam keys
[*] A "Pre-Beta" patch will be rolled out to the Alpha channel before launch
[*] Skycon will coincide with the Beta release, showcasing gameplay and trailers
[/list]
[h3]Beta 2 - 2025/2026[/h3]

The second Major Beta phase will introduce the Foryoku Dynasty. Feedback from the first Beta will be integrated. 
[list]
[*] Foryoku Dynasty content will parallel Drakonia with 5 districts for the first Era
[*] A limited round of new participants will be invited to join the testing phase
[/list]
[h3]Early Access - 2026 [/h3]

To enter Early Access, features from Beta 1 and 2 will be expanded based on feedback, and the Rokkuhito Dynasty will be added as a playable faction. Co-op Multiplayer will also be integrated. 
[list]
[*] Early Access marks the official release of Skyclimbers
[*] Increased likelihood of cross-platform availability at launch
[*] All three Dynasties—Drakonian, Foryoku, and Rokkuhito—will be feature complete
[/list]
[h3]As we progress, we will continue to update this roadmap to reflect our development milestones.[/h3]

[i]Given the challenges of meeting previous timelines and considering our limited team's size, we're taking a more direct approach to manage expectations. We're focused on steady progress and delivering Skyclimbers with the quality and depth it deserves, while keeping expectations aligned with our realistic goals. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]
[h3]This was the longest gap in community updates since the Kickstarter was funded, and we aim to improve moving forward. [/h3]

[i]Quiet periods from a developer can be alarming, and your patience is much appreciated. [/i]

[b]We plan to keep updates more frequent from here on out and thank the community for supporting Paratope through the years. [/b]

Until next time.

[h3]⚠️ Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1362000/view/4669760442588937320?l=english]here[/url] to read the first half of the update! [/h3]

notes.notes:

[h2]We're halfway through 2022, here is what to expect for the rest of the year in our most recent  [url=https://www.paratope.co/blog/mid-year-development-update]blog post. [/url][/h2]

[list]
[*]     Patch 1.0.8 is our biggest update yet, and will release later this month on PC 
[*]     Skycon will line up with this years October Steam Next Fest 
[*]     The focus of 2022 will be to polish the single-player experience in the Drakonian Dynasty
[*]     Pilot programs for Stadia and console Alphas are planned for later in the year. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/95e1cc61ce1a070f8dcef48ad802f21f42e6da15.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 1.0.8 is our first major release post Alpha 1.0.0 and will introduce cooking mechanics along with many fundamental performance and quality improvements. [/h2]

[list]
[*]     New resources have been added to each biome, which spawn at different rarity levels 
[*]     In total over a dozen new resources can be found across the Drakonian continent! 
[*]     The first iteration of the cooking system allows for simple ingredient recipes 
[*]     We have laid the foundation for future recipes that have processed ingredient requirements 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/971d2238129634409b26c582ab49b1275c2d1df9.gif[/img]

[h3]First, our artist Gael began with some basic ingredient and recipe concepts...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/a8dd205687c09e6ca921ecb143b98c4f7198570b.gif[/img]

[h3]Next, our modeler Leo brought each resource and corresponding ingredient to life with a textured 3D asset.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/4b75f337a0a39c290c7789a22bd841b83312e10e.gif[/img]

[h3]Lastly, each resource was carefully programmed into the world algorithm to match the corresponding biome. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/f0641b31c782d1160a2eddc39cc9931e13ed70f2.gif[/img]
[h3]
A discovery system prompts the player upon finding a new resource. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b9eb4efe76f253741d89d08ab38a3e34ab2f70a1.gif[/img]

[h3]Once you have all the proper resources, you can begin using the cooking interface at randomly spawned cooking stations. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3eeabff7e3c511efa505e20e16428ecaf312c9ed.png[/img]

[h3]To prepare for the next patch 1.0.9 we have also integrated a new set of Yagi camp assets. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/c1da264781bc0bdca1230dc0e230c46eb6788c1a.png[/img]
[h3]
For now, you will be able to cook at these locations using the cooking pot, and eventually will be able to encounter groups of the Yagi.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[h2]In addition to all of this, we have taken the time to make fundamental performance updates to the world generation which should provide significant frame rate boosts across all hardware profiles. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/7cdf695c16ccffd2e9ecb2f98939ac06f1e5c09a.png[/img]

[h2]Our art team was able to overhaul 50 Sentipedia graphic art renders which have been published on our website: [url=https://www.skyclimbers.net/sentipedia]https://www.skyclimbers.net/sentipedia[/url] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/212406032a24a4acbf3ad30db963a6fae0e2a10b.png[/img]
[h2]
Each graphic art is used as a reference for the 3D modeling/animation of the Sentius as well as marketing material for Steam trading cards. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/e6caeff92b2ab8fb79ad4e399fd3e35a614b1be8.gif[/img]
[h2]
Our animator Isadora has been hard at work with new Sentius animations:
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/8a23b1f54b1eb43ec29646d703b3491672ae526b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/0da06f7dc7fe69a3b70e1d826503a692c5b2cb96.jpg[/img]

[h3]Art/Design spent some time this sprint preparing for a city generation overhaul. [/h3]

[b]The next iteration of city generation will be more robust, with finer details along with distinct Era progression. In addition, the architectural cues from each biome will be individual to the resources available there. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/b2626a03fd7091ebb3fe73e6ca61ba29df05553a.png[/img]
[h2]
This also means greater attention to detail for the modeling department to draw from. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/3c8530c29778d6695b4f70e2a86cf02adc249620.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

 We will begin shipping USBs in groups of 500 after getting initial feedback on the product. [/h3]

[h2]
Dynasty editions are complete with their own box art, descriptions, and inserts. 💨🔥🪨
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/ba60308755ce67f6cb07cd528a56e0e9dddbf11a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

US backers can expect their life-size plush to ship very soon!

Our newest trailer premiered in June to showcase the Drakonian Magma biome. [/h2]
[h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/cf9a56df74815e9c83a3b3dddd8bf1768a5a457d.gif[/img]

The trailer showcases new Sentius, locations, and class animations / models!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38957884/596d16b4a97edd63484c63c1218e33eeedb13c38.png[/img]

[h1]An update on our Pre-alpha development cycle...
[/h1]
[h3]
You can still sign up for Pre-alpha testing: [url=https://mailchi.mp/2b790159b005/skyclimbers]Sign up [/url][/h3]

    [list]
[*] There has been a change to how Pre-Alpha will be managed going forward. Instead of the originally planned pre-alpha rounds after each new system is implemented, we have decided to move the testing rounds together, to take place in the weeks before Alpha release in Q3. 

[*]     We have made this decision since several of the systems meant for later testing rounds are already being implemented, while some of the earlier systems still require some more work. 

[*]     As a result, initial testing goals for each round have been shifted and we feel that it will be more beneficial to perform the Pre-alpha  Tests and Feedback after all critical systems have been implemented.

[*]     Our stance on NDA for Pre-alpha has also had to be adjusted. We will be maintaining NDA throughout Pre-Alpha testing rounds, however, later Alpha releases will be NDA-free. This is also due to the fact that testing rounds will be isolated in some cases, and represent gameplay scenarios from the mid or late game for the purposes of testing systems at scale. 

[*]     With a large backlog of showcases, gameplay, and informational videos, allowing our team to fully realize our vision prior to launch without interruption will benefit the community as a whole. We appreciate the excitement that so many users have shown in showcasing  Skyclimbers as well as helping us improve our game.

[*]     Despite these changes to the schedule of release for Pre-alpha and its management, we will be continuing to post updates and content related to the game through our various social media channels. This means more un-cut gameplay so that we can continue to showcase the features being developed in a transparent fashion. We highly recommend following us on Youtube, Instagram, Twitter, Reddit, and Steam or otherwise joining our Discord where you can keep up with development more closely.
[/list]


[b]We understand that this news may be disappointing, however, we feel this is necessary to ensure that we deliver a quality game to you upon release. From all of us here at Paratope, thank you so much for your continued support as we work to bring you a new adventure like no other 😎[/b]
